scope.description: Automatic continuation of implicit joint exit under a stable leader after failed transfer, with all emitted storage/application work completed and ordinary ticking/message delivery continued.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine participants and valid initial configuration.
Synchronous caller persists before sends, applies entries/configurations before Advance, and processes all emitted work in order.
Transfer attempt may lose a TimeoutNow; after timeout the suffix delivers all network traffic and ticks every node.
No independent new client proposal or manual leave-joint is owed.
excluded: A fixed elapsed-time or tick deadline for leaving joint.
External client read completion or whole-cluster safety violation.
Schedules with missing application completion, unavailable quorum, leadership change or explicit joint mode.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Replace physical transport/storage with a deterministic in-process network and MemoryStorage.

Record read-only recursive protocol state; omit logger/traceLogger, MemoryStorage.Mutex and MemoryStorage.callStats because execution is single-threaded and these do not determine the next protocol transition.
Corrected active_result samples the live AutoLeave flag instead of the Status.Config copy; retains status_auto_leave separately.

plan_uncertainties: A nonrepeating finite window does not establish nontermination or a missed deadline.
The finite recurrence justifies an indefinitely repeatable suffix only if the correspondence review validates captured state and the fixed scheduler.
The post-result client proposal changes the input policy and is diagnostic only.
grounding_unresolved: The proposed recurrence observation must account for all behavior-determining state, queued messages, timers, callbacks and caller work.
Current execution and semantic correspondence must establish actual recurrence and sufficiency of excluded instrumentation fields.

blockers: Open review issue e1eeee7602dc462387caaba045e935ae [S-config-clone,S-status-clone,S-joint-flag,S-applied,S-raw-advance,S-heartbeat-tick]: Execution exited 0 and completed every emitted Ready; no prerequisite failure explains the false flag.; The recursive protocol state at both endpoints retains active AutoLeave:true while the Status copy exposes false.; The post-observation rescue leaves joint state; it is a new stimulus, not automatic completion in the principal suffix.
